title: Model selection filters deployment providers, preserves account models and applies display aliases safely
steps: Run the model policy, alias, wire and Help & about tests against the branch source with the TAP reporter.
Require the named assertions below to pass; this case does not call a paid LLM or mutate a user session.
expect: Disabled operator providers are excluded while connected personal account groups remain available.
Deployment aliases leave routing IDs and personal account model names unchanged.
Browser IDs stay stable across labels and are encoded in catalog, history and stream projections.
The prompt identity preserves current site rules and treats aliases only as display data.
Web Help displays download/version/changelog and respects its operator switch; desktop hides its preference switches.
fence: Operator/provider availability, account ownership, opaque route serialization, prompt preservation and UI switch policy. Stand screenshots are separate acceptance evidence.

tests: deployment aliases change names only, leaving personal account models untouched
public IDs are stable, route-specific and independent of display aliases
catalog, defaults, replies, history and stream projections share public IDs
Tracy identity uses display aliases as data and preserves the complete effective prompt
web download version links to its changelog and respects the operator switch
desktop update preferences stay out of the UI for either saved value
desktop notification preferences stay out of the UI for either saved value
disabled, unreadable and unconfigured operator accounts are excluded
catalog covers each connected provider and separates accounts of the same provider
ownership is checked before dsh changes a selection, and Tracy AI clears the account pin
